useCase: Analyzing frequency energy distribución anomalías in generado por IA images
mechanism: Decomposes the image into low, mid, and high frequency sub-bands using Butterworth bandpass filters. Computes energy distribución a través de bands and compares ratios. AI generators typically produce images with anomalous energy concentration in specific frequency bands due to their architecture limitations.
name: Análisis de Banda de Frecuencia
source: Frank et al. (2020) - Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition, ICML
parameters: Filter type: Butterworth order 4, Bands: low (0-0.1π), mid (0.1π-0.4π), high (0.4π-π), Metrics: band energy ratio, spectral centroid
description: Decomposes image into multiple frequency sub-bands using filter banks. generado por IA images show anomalous energy distribución a través de bands due to upsampling artefactos.

references.title: Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks Are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures frequency-domain signatures of different AI models
• Complements dominio espacial análisis
• Adjustable band parameters for different generators
• Relatively robust to dominio espacial manipulacións
limitations:
• Requires careful band parameter tuning
• compresión JPEG affects high-frequency análisis
• Less distinctive for high-quality diffusion outputs
• Performance varies with image content type
